evals.prompt: Write the SAP for our retrospective cohort study: adult ICU patients with septic shock (inclusion: norepinephrine >0.1 mcg/kg/min), exposure is vasopressin started within 6h vs later, primary endpoint is 28-day mortality, observational EHR data from 3 sites. The extract is at data/restricted/shock_v1.parquet and ce-data-qa already produced reports/data-qa/shock_v1.md (GO).
evals.expected_output: Announces SAP mode, consumes the data-QA report before variable/model sections, writes a versioned draft SAP at analysis/sap.md with stable SAP-N.M IDs and explicit estimand/causal assumptions, requires the ce-sap-tabular companion, runs the gap checklist, and presents the post-generation menu.
expectations: Announces 'Entering SAP mode' based on study-design keywords
Reads reports/data-qa/shock_v1.md before writing variable, missingness, cohort-size, or model sections

Writes the SAP to analysis/sap.md (the default path) with sap_version and status frontmatter, keeping status: draft while any estimand, comparator, time-zero, adjustment, or missing-data choice remains unresolved
Requires the ce-sap-tabular companion (analysis/sap-tables/01-overview.csv, 02-outputs.csv, 03-variables.csv) or records an explicit blocker
Does not set status: final without user acceptance and does not run inferential analyses

evals.prompt: plan out adding a CLI flag --site-filter to our cohort-builder package (src/cohort/cli.py) so analysts can restrict to one hospital. should be small.
evals.expected_output: Enters implementation mode, writes a Lightweight plan at docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-NNN-feat-<name>-plan.md with U-ID units, repo-relative file paths, test file paths and concrete test scenarios, and writes no implementation code.
expectations: Writes the plan to docs/plans/ using the YYYY-MM-DD-NNN-<type>-<name>-plan.md naming with the date resolved at runtime
Uses stable U-IDs (U1, U2, ...) with no '- [ ]' checkboxes and lists a test file path plus concrete test scenarios for each feature-bearing unit
Uses only repo-relative paths (e.g. src/cohort/cli.py), never absolute paths
Does not write implementation code or modify src/ files, and presents the post-generation menu after writing

evals.prompt: Draft the statistical analysis plan for the randomized trial of early mobilization vs usual care; primary outcome is ICU-free days at day 28, hypothesis is superiority. We haven't received any data yet.
evals.expected_output: Enters SAP mode, writes a draft SAP with a GAP comment for the missing data profile, keeps variable/model sections provisional, and lists ce-data-qa then ce-model-strategy before ce-sap-tabular as next steps.
expectations: Keeps the SAP at status: draft with a GAP comment noting the missing ce-data-qa column profile
Marks variable, missingness, and model sections as provisional rather than inventing column names or cohort sizes
Lists ce-data-qa followed by ce-model-strategy as required next steps before ce-sap-tabular, ce-sprint, or ce-work
Does not invent tabular SAP workbook rows while data QA is missing
